# Flowsint (`reconurge-flowsint`)

Unlock the power of ethical intelligence with Flowsint, the ultimate open-source OSINT tool. Dive deep into graph-based investigations with cutting-edge enrichers for domains, IPs, organizations, and more!

[Source](https://github.com/reconurge/flowsint)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "reconurge-flowsint"
  name       = "myflowsint"

  parameters = {
    DatabaseUrl   = "..."
    RedisUrl      = "..."
    Neo4jUriBolt  = "..."
    Neo4jUsername = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    AuthSecret = var.auth_secret
    MasterVaultKeyV1 = var.master_vault_key_v1
    Neo4jPassword = var.neo4j_password
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DatabaseUrl` | string | yes | PostgreSQL database connection URL used by Flowsint to store user accounts, investigations, scan results, chat messages, and other application data |
| `RedisUrl` | string | yes | Redis connection URL used for caching, session management, and Celery task queue backend for processing enricher jobs asynchronously |
| `AuthSecret` | string | yes | Secret key used for JWT token signing and user authentication in the FastAPI backend Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `MasterVaultKeyV1` | string | yes | Master encryption key for the secure vault system that stores API keys and sensitive credentials used by enrichers Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `Neo4jUriBolt` | string | yes | Neo4j database Bolt protocol connection URI used for storing and querying the OSINT investigation graph data |
| `Neo4jUsername` | string | yes | Username for authenticating to the Neo4j graph database |
| `Neo4jPassword` | string | yes | Password for authenticating to the Neo4j graph database Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
